children: Sarepta Therapeutics entered into a settlement agreement with REGENXBIO and the University of Pennsylvania to resolve patent disputes related to AAVrh74-based gene therapies, including ELEVIDYS. Sarepta will pay a $39 million lump sum and receive broad releases and covenants not to sue covering specified UPenn patents and REGENXBIO-controlled patents tied to ELEVIDYS and the AAVrh74 capsid. The litigations will be dismissed with prejudice, and each party will bear its own legal costs. The deal is expected to provide greater freedom to operate for Sarepta’s AAVrh74 programs.
